subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support be automatic for existing `sendMessage`/`mediaUrls` payloads, exposed as a new explicit `send-media-group` action, or supported through both with a documented contract?
rationale: Current main already carries multiple media URLs through the standard send path, while the open draft introduces a parallel action and `filePaths` parameter; this choice affects tool prompting, docs, fallback behavior, and plugin API stability.

options.title: Use existing mediaUrls
options.body: Implement `sendMediaGroup` automatically for eligible multi-media `sendMessage`/`mediaUrls` payloads and keep sequential sends as the fallback for non-groupable cases.

options.title: Accept explicit album action
options.body: Sponsor a separate `send-media-group` action if maintainers want albums to be opt-in and documented apart from normal sends.

options.title: Defer until API is chosen
options.body: Keep the issue and draft open but ask the draft author to pause until maintainers choose the permanent message-tool contract.

recommendation.title: Use existing mediaUrls
recommendation.body: Implement `sendMediaGroup` automatically for eligible multi-media `sendMessage`/`mediaUrls` payloads and keep sequential sends as the fallback for non-groupable cases.

likelyOwner.reason: They already drove the prior cleanup review and have recent Telegram action/docs history, making them the best available owner for the API-shape decision.
